principles.description: AI systems must prioritize human safety and wellbeing above all other objectives

cases.case: An AI system designed for healthcare must not recommend treatments that could harm patients, even if those treatments are effective in other contexts.
An autonomous vehicle AI must prioritize the safety of pedestrians and passengers over reaching its destination quickly.

principles.description: AI systems must be transparent in their decision-making processes and capabilities

cases.case: An AI used for loan approvals should provide clear explanations for why an application was approved or denied.
A content recommendation AI should disclose the factors influencing its suggestions to users.

principles.description: AI systems must respect and uphold human rights, dignity, and autonomy

cases.case: An AI system used in hiring must avoid biases that could lead to discrimination against certain groups of people.
A personal assistant AI should respect user privacy and not share personal information without consent.

principles.description: AI systems must be reliable, secure, and resistant to manipulation

cases.case: An AI system used in financial trading must be designed to withstand cyber-attacks and prevent unauthorized access.
A recommendation AI should be tested against adversarial inputs to ensure it does not produce harmful or misleading content.
